# Paths this fork intentionally REMOVES from upstream (mem0ai/mem0).
#
# The upstream-sync workflow re-applies these deletions after every merge so that
# files/folders the fork deleted do NOT silently reappear when upstream later
# touches them (the "deleted folder comes back" problem).
#
# Format: one path per line. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# A path may be a file or a directory; directories are removed recursively.
# Editing this file is the SINGLE control point for "what the fork drops".

# NOTE: server/.env.example is deliberately NOT listed here. This fork owns its
# own template (different defaults, extra variables), and docker-compose plus
# server/AGENTS.md both depend on it existing. Pruning it left fresh clones with
# no way to start. An upstream edit to that file will surface as a conflict,
# which is the point: it tells you upstream added configuration worth reviewing.
